## Weekly Growth Loop

Use this issue to keep SmartAssist growth human-led and evidence-backed.

### Inbound review

- [ ] Review the latest Growth Analytics workflow summary or artifact
- [ ] Check setup-friction issues
- [ ] Check product-feedback issues
- [ ] Check contributor-interest issues
- [ ] Check Discussions for new Q&A, Ideas, or Show and Tell threads

### Outreach

- [ ] Review mention alerts from your listening tools
- [ ] Reply to the highest-signal threads manually
- [ ] Publish at least one maintainer update if there is a real product change

### Conversion

- [ ] Convert repeated questions into docs or troubleshooting updates
- [ ] Turn one real pain point into a focused issue or fix
- [ ] Label at least one contributor-friendly task if new work surfaced

### Evidence

- [ ] Link the most useful issue, discussion, or post from this week
- [ ] Note one thing that improved installs, feedback, or contributor flow

Reference docs:

- `docs/runbooks/growth-engine.md`
- `docs/runbooks/launch-pack.md`
